title: Census every PERMANENT test that reads a per-slice agent-state/ artefact for its CONTENTS, fix genuine couplings, and add a durable guard against regrowth
objective: PR #106 removed ONE coupling: a permanent test (tests/unit/test_clock_inheritance.py) read agent-state/current_contract.json for its CONTENTS, a single-slot file overwritten every slice. That census was scoped to that one file. This slice applies the same discriminator (reads CONTENTS = coupling vs asserts EXISTS/PARSES = durable) to every other agent-state/ artefact, fixes only genuine couplings, and installs a load-bearing guard so the shape cannot silently regrow.

population_measured.method: git ls-files, then per-file substring scan for each artefact name, then AST read of every test hit; plus a directory-walk/iterdir/rglob scan across tests/ for indirect access.

feature_list.json.note: durable, protected; shape check in test_repo_baseline is correct

hits_classified: tests/test_repo_baseline.py: existence+parse of three files and a shape check on the durable/protected feature_list.json. Correct as written; untouched.
tests/unit/test_clock_inheritance.py: reads Python source via AST only; current_contract.json in prose (the #106 remedy). No read.
tests/unit/test_assertion_capture_grounding.py: reads provider YAML + capture fixtures; one docstring provenance citation to an evaluations/ file. No coupling.
tests/integration/test_ingest_sync_savepoint.py: one docstring citation to a vanished AMENDMENT 8 in current_contract.json. No runtime read.
finding: ZERO further runtime couplings. The single coupling of this shape was already removed by #106.
changes: Rewrote two dangling PROSE pointers that cited 'AMENDMENT 8 in agent-state/current_contract.json' (a section that no longer exists in the overwritten single-slot file): tests/integration/test_ingest_sync_savepoint.py and apps/api/app/ingest/config_sync.py now explain the declined check on their own. Updated test_clock_inheritance.py's cross-reference to match.

Added tests/unit/test_no_permanent_test_reads_a_per_slice_agent_state_file.py: an AST guard that fails any permanent test reading a per-slice agent-state/ artefact for its contents. The per-slice file set is derived from the tree at test time (not hand-maintained); feature_list.json is exempt as durable.

proof_obligations.mutation_A: Injecting (REPO_ROOT / 'agent-state/current_contract.json').read_text() into a permanent test makes test_no_permanent_test_reads_a_per_slice_agent_state_file FAIL (exit 1), named offender by file:line.
proof_obligations.mutation_B: open(...), json.loads(...read_text()), and progress.md reader forms each also FAIL the same named guard.
proof_obligations.mutation_C: A feature_list.json read (exempt) and a bare prose mention each still PASS -- the guard is an AST content-read check, not a name-ban.
proof_obligations.mutation_D: Breaking the derivation to an empty set trips the guard's anti-vacuous self-check, so it cannot pass vacuously.
